pages.summary: Corrected native compilation against the prebuilt game and optional internal hashes. Removed maturity labels and historical access-key wording.
Organized portable maths and network NBT into sections and narrowed the java_math export claim to its actual subset. Cut implementation and tick-work commentary.
Retained the index format, installation checks, hpack rules and native dependency tools. Replaced registry operator workflows and changelog with concise author-facing submission instructions.
Removed timing comparisons and implementation rationale while retaining dispatch timing, version comparison, migration markers and logging behaviour.
